match: disputes at risk of sla breach
prompt: Show disputes at risk of SLA breach in the next 24 logical hours.

results.text: 312 disputes are open and 41 are at risk of an SLA breach in the next 24 hours, totalling $186,400 of disputed value at risk. The DUPLICATE_CHARGE reason code in the core_ops queue carries the most risk at 14 disputes.

sql.command:
SELECT queue_id, reason_code, priority, open_dispute_count, sla_risk_count, sla_risk_amount_total
FROM aa_dispute_sla_risk
ORDER BY sla_risk_count DESC, sla_risk_amount_total DESC
